attributes.board_name: New Jersey Audiology and Speech-Language Pathology Advisory Committee (Division of Consumer Affairs)

rules.accepted_credit_types: CE related to the practice of audiology or speech-language pathology from the sources listed in N.J.A.C. 13:44C-6.2(c) (e.g. courses, seminars, webinars; presenting a new seminar up to 10 h; teaching a new college course 6 h per course up to 12 h).
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensees applying for their first biennial renewal are exempt.
rules.notes: 20 credit hours in the preceding biennial renewal period; same rule for audiologists. Rule text from the 2015 adoption of N.J.A.C. 13:44C-6.2 published by the Division of Consumer Affairs.
rules.rule_quote: (a) Except as set forth in (b) below, applicants for biennial license renewal shall complete 20 credit hours of continuing education related to the practice of audiology or speech-language pathology in the preceding biennial renewal period.
